title: Reading the First Tape Family
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $k$ be a natural number, and choose an optional control state, an input-head position, two families of $k$ work tapes with their head positions, and an output word. For each $i<k$, the symbol read from tape $i$ in the combined configuration is the content of the $i$th tape in the first family at its head position.
hypotheses_covered: natural number k and state type S
two k-tape contents Dt and Mt
two k-tape head-position families Dp and Mp
